notes: Pressure Cooker: steam hissing round the lid while it rattles (loop for the 0.8 s windup); anchor = the lid's centre
Hot Oil: the pool where the oil lands, looping while it burns (5 ticks, 2 s); anchor = its centre on the ground
Gong Wave: the wave, drawn pushing right; rotate it to the facing (flip for the west side) and move it from the lid along the line at 300 px/s; anchor = the back of the wave
Simmer, back half: behind the player; anchor = the player's feet; loop for the 3 s channel
Simmer, front half: in front of the player; same anchor and timing as the back half
Searing Lid: the lid dropping (frames 0-2, empty after); anchor = the target's feet; the hit lands on frame 3
Searing Lid: the glowing lid and heat rings under the target (empty for frames 0-2); same anchor and timing
Searing Lid: the steam puffing out at the lid's sides; same anchor and timing
Kettle Scream: the sound ring round the player; anchor = the player's feet; the hits land on frame 3
